system.effect: Effect: Your Rock-Type Pokémon may activate Igneous Tactics as a Standard Action. They freely Shift as though Flying for a number of meters up to your Type-Linked Skill, either moving to an empty square or colliding with another creature. On collision, the user makes a "Melee, 1 Target" Physical attack with an AC of 2, causing the creature to to lose HP equal to the level of Igneous Tactics' user, and become Grounded for 3 Rounds. Unlike similar set damage effects, this collision attack benefits from Bigger and Boulder and Heavy as Schist, as well as any other effects that affect "Melee, 1 Target" and Physical attacks. Neither your Pokemon nor any others collided with suffer fall damage after resolving Igneous Tactics.
